content: HubSpot separates 'personal email connection' (General > Email tab > Actions > Remove) from 'team email in conversations inbox' (Inbox & Help Desk > Inboxes > select inbox > Disconnect). Disconnecting is a distinct, explicit action from re-assignment; conversations can be auto-routed to specific users/teams via a toggle + routing rule, independent of which mailbox record they came from. Confirms pattern: connection record and CRM entity record are separate, linked objects, not fused.
